chiller.reference_cop_boundary: complete air-cooled package including condenser fans; source fan-power-ratio blank
chiller.low_ambient_policy: hold curve at 23.89C below its data domain; conservative minimum-head surrogate, flag every use; not measured low-ambient extrapolation
chiller.high_ambient_policy: outside evidence domain: zero modeled available cooling, explicit domain-invalid/infeasible; no extrapolation

assumptions.resources: Ideal fluid CPU/GPU/MEM global pool, no device placement, SMT, MIG or VRAM; observed averages are not reservations; known Duration; synthetic deadlines; known processed duplicates retained.
assumptions.power: CPU205W TDP and GPU250W board reference; idle45/25W, fixed DIMM3W, host50W, switch100W, constant PSU0.94 are reference/research assumptions, not facility measurements. No memory activity inferred from occupied GB.
assumptions.thermal: One representative mixed thermal node, no rack hotspots or humidity. Geometry, equipment mass/coupling, participating slab and envelope U are bounded assumptions, not calibrated measurements. No free thermal storage: report final energy and enforce common tail.
assumptions.chiller: Public numerical EIR reference, not manufacturer calibration of this facility. Linear source PLR retained without invented gains. Fixed all-module shared load, no staging optimization or storage. Explicit curve-domain handling and subordinate water reset assumptions.
